$comment: How cake serves the compiled local pages (S5.1, assets.py): web/dist from `npm run build` (paths.web_folder). / is index.html (the pages route by the URL's #); any other file is served by its suffix's type, and a suffix not listed here is not served. Vite names the files under assets/ by their content, so a browser may keep them; the pages themselves are asked for again each time.

folders.$comment: Where the compiled pages are (paths.web_folder): $CAKE_WEB_DIR when set; else 'release' inside the package, which a release (wheel, .pyz or unpacked folder: S6.4's release.json names the same folder) carries; else 'checkout' next to the package, where `npm run build` puts them in a checkout.
